searchText: Is there any meaningful research going on around database migrations between client dbs? For example, a tool to migrate dbs from OpenEthereum to Geth would be really helpful given the current rollback of OE stable requiring a re-sync I think OpenEthereum is providing (or going to provide) a migration program as far as I know, they are testing it right now but the answer to your question is basically "no" Thanks Alexey! I have a script which can read a Geth / Parity database and turn it into a format Trinity/py-evm understands But I don't think there's anything which solves the general case
